answer: Sequential work-chain registration: each new agent identity must complete a verifiable task whose output depends on a randomly assigned prior agent's output, forming a chain. A canyon of unverifiable gaps breaks registration. Validation samples prior links; mismatches fail an echo test comparing results against independent recomputation. Every identity must mirror the chain's recent history, so mass registration requires solving each link's task sequentially, costing attacker real compute and elapsed time per identity.
